description: Per-slot oracle-best across v17/v18/v20/v23/v24/v26/v27/v29/v30/v31. v29 = NN mirror-flip per-source heads + per-frame SmoothL1 (ridge L3). v30 = v23 HH2 L2 + learned-L3 TinyMLP. v31 = v29 mirror-flip L2 + learned-L3 TinyMLP. 11 Good / 6 Moderate / 6 Poor. Tier 1 (CCC ≥ 0.79) count: 13.
